# Rust Driver - (current)

> Explore the MongoDB Rust Driver, including setup, code examples, connection troubleshooting, and compatibility with MongoDB Server and Rust language versions.

- [Aggregation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/aggregation.md): Learn to perform aggregation operations in the MongoDB Rust Driver using aggregation pipelines to process and transform data in MongoDB collections.
- [Collations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/aggregation/collations.md): Learn how to use collations in the MongoDB Rust Driver to order query results by string values according to specific language and locale conventions.
- [API Documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/api.md)
- [Run a MongoDB Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/atlas-search.md): Learn about how to use MongoDB Search with the MongoDB Rust driver.
- [Connection to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect.md): Explore how to configure connections to a MongoDB deployment using the Rust driver, including options for network compression and TLS.
- [Specify Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/connection-options.md)
- [Manage Connections with Connection Pools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/connection-options/connection-pools.md): Learn how to configure and optimize MongoDB Rust Driver connection pools, including settings for performance, concurrency, and resource management.
- [Network Compression](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/connection-options/network-compression.md): Learn to configure network compression for MongoDB connections using the Rust driver, including enabling Snappy, Zlib, and Zstandard compressors.
- [Customize Server Selection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/connection-options/server-selection.md)
- [Stable API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/connection-options/stable-api.md): Learn how to specify Stable API compatibility in the MongoDB Rust Driver to ensure operations align with a defined API version.
- [Choose a Connection Target](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/connection-target.md): Learn how to connect to MongoDB Atlas, local servers, and replica sets by using the Rust driver with code examples.
- [Connection Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/connection-troubleshooting.md): Learn how to troubleshoot potential connection issues with the MongoDB Rust Driver, including server connection, authentication, and DNS resolution errors.
- [Create a MongoDB Client](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/mongodb-client.md): Learn how to connect to a MongoDB instance or replica set using the Rust driver, including connection URI details and client creation methods.
- [Performance Considerations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/connect/performance.md): Learn to optimize MongoDB Rust Driver performance by reusing Client instances, running parallel operations, and managing synchronous and asynchronous runtimes.
- [CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud.md): Explore how to perform CRUD operations with the MongoDB Rust Driver, including reading, writing, and modifying documents in MongoDB.
- [Bulk Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/bulk.md): Learn to perform bulk write operations by using the MongoDB Rust Driver, including insert, replace, update, and delete operations across multiple namespaces.
- [Compound Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/compound-operations.md): Learn to perform compound operations by using the MongoDB Rust Driver, combining read and write actions into atomic operations to prevent data changes.
- [Configure CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/configure.md): Learn how to configure read and write operations in the MongoDB Rust Driver, including how to set read preferences, read concerns, and write concerns.
- [Delete Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/delete.md): Learn how to delete documents from MongoDB collections with the MongoDB Rust Driver.
- [GridFS](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/gridfs.md): Learn to store and retrieve large files in MongoDB using GridFS with the Rust driver, including file upload, download, and management operations.
- [Insert Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/insert.md): Learn how to insert documents into a MongoDB collection with the MongoDB Rust Driver, including options for single and multiple document inserts.
- [Query Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query.md): Learn about read operations in the MongoDB Rust Driver, including querying, retrieving data, using cursors, and sorting, skipping, and limiting results.
- [Count Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/count.md): Learn to count documents in a MongoDB collection using the MongoDB Rust Driver, with examples for both asynchronous and synchronous runtimes.
- [Access Data by Using a Cursor](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/cursor.md): Learn to use the MongoDB Rust Driver to access data with a cursor, enabling iteration through documents while managing memory efficiently.
- [Retrieve Distinct Field Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/distinct.md): Find distinct field values in a MongoDB collection with the MongoDB Rust Driver.
- [Geospatial Queries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/geo.md): Learn how to search geospatial data with the MongoDB Rust Driver, including storing data, creating indexes, and performing geospatial queries.
- [Find Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/retrieve.md): Learn how to retrieve data from MongoDB collections by using the MongoDB Rust Driver with find operations, including examples for finding one or many documents.
- [Specify Documents to Return](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/specify-documents.md): Learn how to specify documents in the MongoDB Rust Driver, including filtering documents using queries.
- [Specify Fields to Return](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/specify-fields.md): Learn how to specify fields in the MongoDB Rust Driver, including projecting specific fields in query results.
- [Specify a Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/specify-query.md): Learn how to specify queries with the MongoDB Rust Driver to match subsets of documents using query filters, comparison operators, and various criteria.
- [Query Text](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/query/text-search.md): Learn how to perform text queries with the MongoDB Rust Driver, such as creating text indexes, searching for terms or phrases, and sorting results by relevance.
- [Transactions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/transactions.md): Learn to perform transactions  with the MongoDB Rust Driver, ensuring atomicity and ACID compliance for operations within logical sessions.
- [Update Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/update.md): Learn how to modify MongoDB documents by using update operations with the Rust driver, including examples and method options.
- [Update Arrays in a Document](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/update/embedded-arrays.md): Learn how to update array fields in MongoDB documents by using the Rust driver, including positional operators and array filters.
- [Replace Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/update/replace.md): Learn how to replace MongoDB documents by using the Rust driver, including examples and method options.
- [CRUD Web App with Rocket](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/crud/web-app-tutorial.md)
- [Data Formats](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/data-formats.md): Explore how to work with data formats such as BSON and work with serialization by using the Rust driver.
- [Bounds and Bounds Errors](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/data-formats/bounds.md): Learn how to work with bounds in the MongoDB Rust driver to enforce restrictive typing and resolve common bounds errors.
- [Work with BSON Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/data-formats/bson.md): Learn how to work with BSON data in the MongoDB Rust driver. Construct documents, serialize Rust types, customize serialization, and read and write BSON files.
- [Result and Option Enums](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/data-formats/result-option.md): Learn how to work with the Result and Option enums as return values in the MongoDB Rust driver.
- [Data Modeling and Serialization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/data-formats/serialization.md): Learn how the MongoDB Rust Driver handles BSON and Rust type conversions using Serde for serialization and deserialization, with custom data modeling examples.
- [Time Series Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/data-formats/time-series.md): Learn to create and interact with time series collections with the MongoDB Rust Driver, including creating collections and querying them efficiently.
- [Databases and Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/database-collection.md): Learn how to use the Rust driver to manage MongoDB databases and collections, including accessing, listing, creating, and dropping them.
- [Get Started with Rust](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/get-started.md): Learn how to install the Rust driver, connect your Rust application to a MongoDB Atlas cluster, and query a database collection in this get started guide..
- [MongoDB Rust Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/index.md): Explore the MongoDB Rust Driver, including setup, code examples, connection troubleshooting, and compatibility with MongoDB Server and Rust language versions.
- [Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/indexes.md): Learn to create and manage indexes with the MongoDB Rust Driver to enhance query performance in MongoDB.
- [MongoDB Search and Vector Search Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/indexes/atlas-search-indexes.md): Learn to create and manage MongoDB Search indexes for fast, full-text searches on data in an Atlas cluster using the Rust driver.
- [Third-Party Integrations and Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/integrations.md): Explore third-party integrations and tools that work with the MongoDB Rust Driver, such as web frameworks Rocket and Actix, and discover related tutorials.
- [Issues & Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/issues-and-help.md): Find support for the MongoDB Rust Driver, report bugs or request features in JIRA, and create pull requests to contribute.
- [Monitoring and Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/monitoring-logging.md): Explore monitoring, logging, and tracing techniques by using the MongoDB Rust Driver.
- [Open Change Streams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/monitoring-logging/change-streams.md): Learn to use change streams with the MongoDB Rust Driver to monitor real-time data changes, including filtering events and configuring pre- and post-images.
- [Monitor Application Events](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/monitoring-logging/monitoring.md): Explore how to configure cluster, command, and connection pool monitoring in the MongoDB Rust Driver and understand different types of monitoring events.
- [Tracing & Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/monitoring-logging/tracing-logging.md): Learn how to configure tracing and logging i with the MongoDB Rust Driver to observe application activities with different levels of detail.
- [Operation Error Handling](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/op-error-handling.md): Learn how to handle MongoDB Rust Driver operation errors, including WriteError, BulkWriteError, and ConnectionPoolCleared error types and recovery strategies.
- [Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/reference.md): Find reference materials about Rust driver compatibility and new features.
- [Quick Reference Syntax Examples](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/reference/quick-reference.md): Explore examples of common tasks using the MongoDB Rust Driver, using asynchronous or synchronous runtimes.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/reference/release-notes.md): Discover new features, improvements, and fixes in recent versions of the MongoDB Rust Driver.
- [Upgrade Major Versions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/reference/upgrade.md)
- [View the Source](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/reference/view-source.md)
- [Run a Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/run-command.md): Learn how to execute database commands for administrative and diagnostic tasks with the MongoDB Rust Driver, including syntax and response handling.
- [Asynchronous and Synchronous APIs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/runtimes.md): Learn to configure and use the MongoDB Rust Driver's asynchronous and synchronous APIs, including examples and setup instructions for both runtimes.
- [Schema Validation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/schema-validation.md): Learn to implement schema validation in MongoDB collections using the Rust driver by defining JSON schema rules during collection creation.
- [Security](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security.md): Learn how to secure your MongoDB Rust driver connections with guides on authentication, in-use encryption, and TLS/SSL configuration.
- [Authentication Mechanisms](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/authentication.md)
- [AWS IAM](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/authentication/aws-iam.md)
- [Kerberos (GSSAPI)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/authentication/kerberos.md)
- [LDAP (PLAIN SASL)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/authentication/ldap.md)
- [OIDC (Workload Identity Federation)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/authentication/oidc.md)
- [SCRAM](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/authentication/scram.md)
- [X.509](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/authentication/x509.md)
- [In-Use Encryption](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/in-use-encryption.md)
- [Enable and Configure TLS](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/security/tls.md): Learn how to secure your MongoDB connection using TLS by enabling the protocol, configuring certificates, and referencing them in a client.
- [MongoDB Vector Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/rust/current/vector-search.md)
